nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Nano-4B-BF16.why: transformers 5.5.3's built-in Nemotron-H has no plain MLP layers (the '-' in this model's hybrid_override_pattern: they came in 5.6.0), and the repo's own code, written for transformers 4.53, builds its hybrid cache only when generation passes none, which 5.x's generation always does
